notes: Audit severity: LOW but real. The issue is: per-fold refit (5 folds × model retrain) with permutation test (200 shuffles) + bootstrap (1000 samples) creates 5 concurrent or sequential subprocess workers under LOKY backend without thread capping. Observed peak RSS = 5.9 GB. Currently mitigated externally by operator-set LOKY_MAX_CPU_COUNT=1 environment variable. No user-facing harm in current deployment because env var is set. Fix is straightforward: (1) import threadpoolctl, (2) clone(model, n_jobs=1) if the model stores n_jobs param, (3) wrap fit with `with threadpool_limits(limits=1, user_api='blas'): fold_model.fit(...)`. The audit is PARTIAL because it correctly identified the spike and the mechanism, but the assessment 'no user-facing harm' hinges on the external env var being set — if an operator forgets to set LOKY_MAX_CPU_COUNT=1, the agent will spike to 5.9 GB on any cohort with training data large enough to trigger CV.
